entities.summary: Solomiia Opryshko, more popularly known by her stage name Klavdia Petrivna is a Ukrainian singer, songwriter and musician who hid her identity at the beginning of her career. She gained rapid popularity on the social network TikTok. Her tracks have gained millions of plays on YouTube and streaming services. In early 2024, she topped the charts of Ukrainian radio stations with the song "Znaidy mene".
